responsibility: This AWK generator reads merged .opt records and emits the C implementation side of GCC option handling, typically options.cc. It coalesces duplicate options across languages, validates and expands EnabledBy and LangEnabledBy relationships, generates option metadata tables and automatic option handlers for front ends and cpplib integration, and emits plugin-visible variable offset tables. Its responsibility is code generation for command-line option processing logic, not the option declarations themselves.
